subject: Optivium POC - expanded credit + trial extension request
messages:
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@optivium.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Optivium POC Team <poc-team@optivium.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: POC scope update — request for larger trial allowance and extra 30 days

Hi Karthik,

Quick update from our side — after running a couple of internal simulations the POC scope has grown. We originally estimated ~5M tokens for the full-week run, but with the larger context windows and higher TPM (peaks of ~18k TPM during concurrent user testing), we're projecting ~40–50M tokens over the 30-day POC. The models we want to validate also require longer contexts (up to 32k tokens) which will increase per-token costs and throughput needs.

Can Redwood increase the initial free credit grant and extend the trial by 30 days? Specifically: 1) bump the self-serve trial allowance to cover ~45M tokens (or an equivalent $ allowance), and 2) add a 30-day extension on top of the standard trial so we can finish performance validation and fairness checks.

Attached: Optivium_POC_Specs_v2.pdf and POC_token_estimate.xlsx with a brief cost calc. We're flexible on a few constraints (e.g., daily rate limits) but want predictable headroom so the engineering team can stress test.

Happy to jump on a call if useful.

Thanks,
Sarah Jensen
Head of ML Platforms | Optivium

---
Attachment: Optivium_POC_Specs_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: POC_token_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the details and the breakdown.

This is the kind of POC where we prefer to grant additional self-serve credits rather than push to a manual quote — makes it faster for you to validate. I'm going to loop in my manager (Marissa) and revenue ops (Lauren) to get signoff for a one-time expanded grant and the 30-day extension. Please allow 24–48 hours for internal approval.

Couple of clarifying questions that will help expedite approval:
- Do you need the expanded allowance available immediately for a smoke test, or can we schedule activation on Monday (2027-05-17)?
- Any compliance constraints (e.g., IP, data residency) beyond what we discussed in the onboarding doc?

I'll follow up as soon as I have confirmation.

Best,
Karthik

Karthik / Lauren — reviewed Optivium's spec and token estimate. Scope looks legitimate: larger context + sustained TPM for stress testing. Approve the following one-time self-serve grant under PLG allowances:

- Credit equivalent: $6,000 (approx. covers ~48M tokens on their baseline model mix)
- Trial extension: +30 days from existing trial expiry (automated flag in Console)
- Activation: we can enable immediately upon issuance (no further contract required).

Please ensure: 
- Grant is tagged to DEAL-78321 and Optivium workspace (so usage attribution & guardrails are correct).
- Daily rate limit: set a soft cap at 250k TPM with a burst cap if they request it later; notify us if they hit the soft cap.
- Require the Optivium PO/finance contact to confirm acceptance of grant terms within 7 days (attach the grant terms PDF).

Marissa
Director, GTM | Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Grant issued: Optivium POC expanded credits & trial extension

Hi Sarah — good news: we've approved the one-time grant. Details below and next steps to consume the credits from your side.

Grant summary:
- Amount: $6,000 equivalent (approx. 48M tokens across their chosen model mix)
- Extension: +30 days added to your trial (effective immediately)
- Daily soft cap: 250k TPM (burst available by request)
- Tagging: READABLE: DEAL-78321 / Optivium workspace

How to claim the grant (self-serve flow):
1) Sign into your Optivium workspace on the Redwood Console.
2) Navigate to Settings → Grants. You should see a pending grant titled "Optivium POC — expanded trial allowance".
3) Click "Claim" and accept the attached grant terms PDF.

Link: https://redwood.app/console/grants/DEAL-78321

I've attached the grant terms PDF in case you need to route to finance. If you prefer, we can also export a grant acknowledgment and have finance sign it — let me know.

Next steps for us: I'll monitor usage for the first 72 hours and loop in Rishi if we see sustained bursts above the soft cap. If you want the daily cap raised, request via this thread and we'll fast-track approval based on usage patterns.

Thanks and excited to see the test results.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
